description: Product Genius | Backend Engineer | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | $165k–$190k + equity We build real-time learning AI: the APIs and data pipelines connecting live user and merchant behavior to systems that learn from it. Patented tech, backed by $35M in DARPA-funded R&D. AI-native team, you'll use agentic coding tools daily, including running multiple parallel sessions, on a fast-moving codebase. We share context, not tickets. Looking for 5+ years building production backend systems, hands-on agentic AI coding experience, and experience with APIs/data pipelines feeding analytics or ML systems. Python, SQL, TypeScript, React. Apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/productgenius/b9f0cb32-612d-45ff-bc...
